method: Incremental browser scan of 11 tracked Reddit discussions, compared against IDs and comment text saved at the October 28 expanded review
coverage: Incremental new-sort browser scan of 11 tracked threads: 133 visible comments compared with saved IDs/text. Older comments and nested replies were not re-expanded. Last expanded review on Oct 28 at 3:11 PM ET: 304 accessible of 325 displayed; 21 inaccessible.
